topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I tell ye, the day started just like any other, but it ain’t ending the same. My son, he was in town, running errands for the harvest. Stopped by the old pawn shop on the way back, just to pass the time. He was telling me about how he stumbled upon a ring, small but shining bright, just like the one my ma wore when she was a young lass. Felt a tug, he did, and bought it right away. Brought it home, and there we sat, turning it over in the light. Sure enough, there was the maker’s mark, just like the stories. We’ve kept it safe, a piece of our past come back to us. It’s a fine day, it is.
